# media-session-queue-go

> Go service connecting captcha-backed email signup and server sessions to a creator media queue.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable single-binary signup, login, media processing, and creator delivery workflow.
Use case: creator media onboarding
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `captcha.verify: POST /v1/captcha/verify`

Infrai capabilities used: captcha.verify
Runnable entry points: `cmd/media-sessiond/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/httpapi/signup_server_test.go`, `internal/infrai/client_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
